project.objective: Establish which of the two recorded deaths for Ambrose Keane is his, and recover a defensible birth year

questions.question: Which birth year and which death date on Ambrose Keane's profile belong to the same man?
questions.rationale: The profile carries a birth of about 1785 and two deaths, 1908 and 1909, giving a recorded lifespan of over 120 years. At least one of the three dates belongs to a different Ambrose Keane, or was mis-transcribed. Settling which is the precondition for any further work on him.

log.notes: 1850 census entry gives an age of 65, implying a birth of about 1785. No other census entry for this man has been located.

sources.citation: 1850 U.S. census, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, population schedule, dwelling 61, Ambrose Keane; digital image, FamilySearch.org, accessed 19 Sep 2026.
sources.notes: Age 65 in 1850. Census ages are routinely rounded or misreported, so this birth year is an estimate and is the weakest of the three dates in question.

assertions.informant: unknown household member reporting to the enumerator
assertions.informant_bias_notes: Derived from a stated age of 65, not from a birth record.
